# Raw Readiness original reference before native implementation

Raw Readiness 4E0960: local original-reference preparation, no native engine

The original-reference artifacts described here were prepared outside the repository. No Go
build/test, GitHub CI operation, network access, repository/oracle-manifest
edit, native implementation or excluded historical product recovery ran.

The untouched original GAME.EXE SHA256 is
0040e2c0683b4d73a5fb976e400d5087dca680df2b195c9e27f8edbda2d4974a.
Complete root extent is 004E0960..004E09A3, 68 bytes and 25 instructions,
SHA256 dd2e32642e9c728d4d6c6efb83957760d70c9cc4d7054fbc042d32e3db9319a8.
The following twelve bytes are NOP alignment, not root execution credit.
004E0950 is nullsub_22: the root compares that callback identity without
calling it. There are no helper-call bodies or external service substitutions.

The independent generator chooses 113 inputs and computes no expected return,
fault, branch or native result. It was generated and checksum-pinned before
the original producer executed. Domains include item/null/bad/last-field,
InitData table and descriptor edge pointers, all relevant class mask bits,
eligible slots2/3 versus ineligible slots0/1, matching/mismatching/null/bad
callback identities, signed DWORD extremes, first-match priority and zero
strength. Independent after-read stimuli distinguish cached InitData/class,
the first slot load, live/cached callback and strength, and the decisive
post-match reload of the same modifier slot. Replacement/null/bad reloaded
descriptors have separate cases. The callback on the replacement descriptor
is deliberately not matching: a raw port must not recheck it after the reload.

Both actual original PC53 FPU profiles, control0x0e3f and0x023f, passed locally.
Per profile:113 inputs,611 ordered reads,29 declared stimulus writes,20 memory
faults, all25 instructions reached and zero helper invocations. All64KiB
initial/final heaps and stacks, ordered stack/stimulus writes, the untouched
full mapped PE image, original caller words, successful return registers/
stack balance, fault instruction/register state and unchanged FPU control/
status are checked. Both complete output byte streams are identical.
